app.title: Gravity Desktop
settings.title: Gravity Desktop Settings
settings.autostart: Start Gravity Desktop when I sign in to Windows
settings.autostart.current_user: This setting affects only the current Windows user.
settings.autostart.repair: The startup entry points to an old path. Turn it on again to repair it.
settings.restart_required: Some interfaces will update after Gravity Desktop restarts.
settings.instant_preview: Changes preview immediately and save automatically.
settings.workspace.reset_view.descriptio: Reset View restores only canvas zoom and view offset. Cores, files, and relationships do not change.
settings.data.layout_snapshot.descriptio: Saves and restores positions of existing cores and files. New content remains; removed content does not return.
settings.data.full_backup.description: Restores cores, file references, and relationships. Differences are shown first; cores with over 18 items continue in a new core.
settings.core.reference_check.descriptio: Checks file references in cores that are missing or can no longer be found.
settings.help.tutorial.description: Open the three-step tutorial again. It does not create test files or change your current layout.
settings.advanced.data_folder.descriptio: The program data folder contains state, backups, and logs. Do not delete files you do not recognize.
settings.advanced.report.description: Problem reports contain only redacted runtime logs and window state. Nothing is uploaded.
